# Janjua's English Lit Notes

> English literature study guides by Qaisar Iqbal Janjua: exam study editions of the English literature works taught worldwide, for students in schools, colleges and universities wherever English literature is taught. Every book gives the complete original text with a plain modern English line under every line, word notes, model answers for every unit and twelve model essays.

Status: All four are on Amazon now as Kindle ebooks, with paperbacks to follow. Free PDF samples are available now. The series is an independent study aid, not affiliated with any university, examination board or publisher.

## Books

- [The General Prologue to The Canterbury Tales: Exam Edition](https://www.janjuaslitnotes.com/books/general-prologue-study-guide/): General Prologue study guide. Original author: Geoffrey Chaucer. Text: Skeat's edition (Oxford, 1900), lines 1 to 858. 24 units (one for each pilgrim or section of the poem), 12 model essays, 180 objective questions, a bank of 40 quotations, 26 character drawings. Paperback 6 x 9 in, 351 pages; Kindle ebook. Kindle ebook on Amazon now: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMRCQ57Y; paperback coming soon.
- [Hamlet: Exam Edition](https://www.janjuaslitnotes.com/books/hamlet-study-guide/): Hamlet study guide. Original author: William Shakespeare. Text: the Cambridge Shakespeare, edited by W. G. Clark and W. A. Wright (1866). 17 units (one for each scene or group of scenes), 12 model essays, 145 objective questions, a bank of 48 quotations, 15 character drawings. Paperback 6 x 9 in, 558 pages; Kindle ebook. Kindle ebook on Amazon now: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HMRDSDKR; paperback coming soon.
- [Macbeth: Exam Edition](https://www.janjuaslitnotes.com/books/macbeth-study-guide/): Macbeth study guide. Original author: William Shakespeare. Text: the Cambridge Shakespeare, edited by W. G. Clark and W. A. Wright (Volume VII, Macmillan, 1865). 13 units (one for each scene or group of scenes), 12 model essays, 105 objective questions, a bank of 40 key passages, 14 character drawings. Paperback 6 x 9 in, 367 pages; Kindle ebook. Kindle ebook on Amazon now: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0H1KB3V32; paperback coming soon.
- [King Lear: Exam Edition](https://www.janjuaslitnotes.com/books/king-lear-study-guide/): King Lear study guide. Original author: William Shakespeare. Text: the Cambridge Shakespeare, edited by William George Clark and William Aldis Wright (Volume VIII, Macmillan, 1866). 15 units (one for each scene or group of scenes), 12 model essays, 115 objective questions, a bank of 40 key passages, 15 character drawings. Paperback 6 x 9 in, 442 pages; Kindle ebook. Kindle ebook on Amazon now: https://www.amazon.com/dp/B0HCTNZLLX; paperback coming soon.
- [The books compared](https://www.janjuaslitnotes.com/books/): all four books side by side.

## What every book contains

- The complete original text, with plain modern English for every line and word notes beneath.
- Units by section or scene, each with a character or scene card, a background box, a critical note, three short answers, a model context answer and five objective questions.
- Twelve model essays on the questions examiners set most often, each with a marked shorter version.
- Practice questions, one-line facts, a bank of key quotations or passages and a last-night checklist.
- Original drawings of every character, in one house style.
- The original texts are public-domain editions (Skeat, Oxford, 1900; the Cambridge Shakespeare, 1865 and 1866), with obvious misprints corrected. Every quotation and line number is checked against the book's text.

## About and contact

- [Corrections](https://www.janjuaslitnotes.com/corrections/): every confirmed error is listed here and fixed in the next printing. First editions: no corrections yet.
- [About Qaisar Iqbal Janjua](https://www.janjuaslitnotes.com/about/): he has written notes for literature students for many years and is relaunching his series as Janjua's English Lit Notes, one book at a time, each rebuilt from the original text.
- [Contact](https://www.janjuaslitnotes.com/contact/): qaisar@janjuaslitnotes.com
- [Privacy and legal notices](https://www.janjuaslitnotes.com/privacy/): no cookies, analytics or tracking; an email is used only for what the sender asked; copyright, public-domain texts, critics' quotations and AI use (AI tools were used in preparing the books, and every quotation, line number, fact and answer was then checked).
